name: affinity-proteomics
justification: Core work is driving two vendor formats under one interface: SomaLogic ADAT parsed via the somadata library and Olink NPX CSV, each with its own QC path (Olink QC_Warning/LOD/sample median vs SomaLogic RowCheck, ColCheck, normalisation scale factors and MAD outlier filtering). The stats layer (t-test or Mann-Whitney with BH FDR) is work any agent could write.

name: analyze-fasta
justification: Algorithm section encodes published conventions a model could rebuild in a session: Biopython gc_fraction and ProtParam, ORF minimum 300 bp / 100 aa, 85% ACGTUN sequence-type threshold, 50% N abort, and Kyte and Doolittle 1982 for GRAVY.

name: ancestry-risk-profiler
justification: The bundled OR panel is D1-style public GWAS data, but the load-bearing content is refusal: a hard InsufficientCoverageError below 30 matched AISNPs (Kosoy 2009 bound), the v1.3.0 soft-posterior gate that skips disease scoring entirely when confidence is low and top posterior < 0.35, the APOL1 recessive_compound model, and the removal of the absolute-lifetime-risk calculation to stop double-counting alleles already in the baseline prevalence.

name: archaic-introgression
justification: Wraps IBDmix, Sprime and hmmix behind one interface with a pure-Python LOD fallback, and parses EIGENSTRAT .geno by checking the 'GENO' magic header to switch to 2-bit binary unpacking; the hard part is driving those three methods and their formats correctly.

name: article-data-fetcher
justification: Workflow step 5 is a mandatory never-skip confirmation of file types before any download, manifest.json records source URL, MD5/SHA256 and timestamp per file, and the Gotchas require deleting a file whose checksum fails and detecting HTTP 401/403 rather than saving an HTML error page as data. Accession discovery is public-API work a model can redo; the refusals and the audit trail are the real loss.

name: bgpt-mcp
justification: Ships no code at all; the file is the connection contract for a third-party MCP server: the search_papers tool at https://bgpt.pro/mcp/sse with query, num_results 1-100 and days_back, an npx local-proxy fallback, and the 50-result free tier. This is exactly the class a harness with its own MCP connector absorbs.

name: bigquery-public
justification: Hard part is driving BigQuery correctly: SELECT/WITH-only validation rejecting multi-statement SQL, ADC auth with a logged-in bq CLI fallback, and default max bytes billed of 1,000,000,000. Its single 'data file' is a 610-byte offline shakespeare demo fixture, not shipped knowledge.

name: bio-orchestrator
justification: Centre of gravity is the routing table and EXTENSION_MAP (.vcf to equity-scorer, .h5ad to scrna-orchestrator) plus header-aware tabular routing (gene + log2FoldChange + padj to diff-visualizer), dispatched by orchestrator.py; it sequences sibling ClawBio skills rather than external binaries, so the D2 fit is by analogy and the safety rules are a thin second layer.

name: bioconductor-bridge
justification: Queries live Bioconductor VIEWS indexes and BiocManager at runtime rather than a committed catalog, inspects the local Rscript setup for release-vs-devel builds, and mutates the environment only when --install is passed.

name: bioqc-mcp
justification: Shells out to fastqc with -o and -t, then multiqc with -o --force, and parses the >>Per base sequence quality and >>Per sequence GC content blocks of fastqc_data.txt. The value is correct invocation and output parsing of two external binaries.

name: busco-assessor
justification: The value is invoking BUSCO v6 correctly: the LINEAGE_ROUTING organism-to-OrthoDB table, the 'sepp=4.5.5 exactly' pin because 4.5.6 silently produces wrong lineage assignments, the rule that eukaryote lineages are _odb10 and prokaryote/archaea are _odb12, and globbing both short_summary.txt and short_summary.specific.*.txt because v6 changed the filename.

name: cell-detection
justification: Value is correct Cellpose invocation: CellposeModel().eval() with cpsam, CZI axes read from CziFile.axes and ND2 from ND2File.sizes for deterministic C/Z/Y/X mapping, 3D called with z_axis=0 and channel_axis=1, and a documented truncate-to-first-3-channels policy.

name: celltype-specificity-profiler
justification: Encodes published formulas and cut-offs: the Yanai 2005 tau index over pseudobulk means, Sarle's bias-corrected bimodality coefficient, TAU_THRESHOLD 0.69 and MIN_CELLS_FOR_TAU 20 from Zhang et al. 2026, and the trial-prior odds ratios 1.27 and 1.11 quoted verbatim from that paper's Results.

name: claw-ancestry-pca
justification: Encodes the PLINK merge path its 'Why this exists' section says a general model gets wrong: contig normalisation (chr1 vs 1), common biallelic SNP intersection, IBD removal of relateds before PCA. Caveat: the claimed bundled SGDP v4 panel is absent from the skill directory and the demo uses pre-computed Peruvian Genome Project results.

name: claw-metagenomics
justification: Encodes Kraken2 confidence threshold 0.2, Bracken species-level re-estimation at minimum 10 reads, and RGI MAIN restricted to Perfect and Strict hits with no Loose, then chains HUMAnN3 with MetaCyc stratification against an 8-70 GB database. The WHO priority-pathogen table is secondary to getting four tools invoked correctly.

name: claw-methylation-cycle
justification: Content is a 9-gene rsID table (rs1801133 C677T, rs1801131 A1298C, rs1801394 A66G, rs4680 Val158Met) mapped to activity percentages, plus bespoke NMC weights (MTHFR 0.35, MTRR 0.15) and BH4 bands; no external tool is invoked. Triage says mentions-external-binary on 'plink', whose single occurrence is the do-NOT-fire line naming PLINK binary as an unsupported input format.

name: claw-semantic-sim
justification: Status section states outright 'Not yet implemented': semantic_sim.py and the 05-00 to 05-05 pipeline scripts are absent and there is no runnable demo. The directory contains SKILL.md only, so SII/KTP/RCC exist as prose specification.

name: clawpathy-autoresearch
justification: What survives a smarter model is the loop's policy, not any lookup: strict-better revert with per-iteration snapshots in loop.py, reference/ kept judge-only with the judge penalising leakage, the ban on hardcoded answers in SKILL.md, and the explicit rule that no deterministic Python scorer may exist because an earlier version's scorer rewarded API-fetching over methodology.

name: clinical-trial-finder
justification: Centre of gravity is the reporting contract: FHIR R4 rather than R5 citing ONC 45 CFR Part 170, TERMINATED and WITHDRAWN trials flagged but never omitted to avoid reporting bias (Chan 2004, PLoS Med), and eligibility criteria deliberately left unparsed rather than NLP-guessed.

name: clinical-variant-prioritizer
justification: prioritize.py call_zygosity returns None when a genotype resolves to neither ref nor alt on either strand, the summary separates reference from not_tested, and the category table demotes a recessive heterozygote to carrier and flags conflicting ClinVar as uncertain, flagged not acted on. The shipped clinical_panel.json is a re-fetchable ClinVar/gnomAD snapshot, so the refusal semantics are what would actually be lost.

name: clinical-variant-reporter
justification: The 28-criteria table and thresholds (BA1 gnomAD AF > 5%, PP3 CADD >= 25.3, ClinVar stars >= 2) are reconstructible from Richards 2015, so the durable half is capability 7: a fail-closed self-audit in its own self_audit.py that hard-abstains on IDENTITY_MISMATCH, CONTRADICTORY_EVIDENCE and MISSING_PROVENANCE and emits abstained: true with machine-readable audit_violations.

name: clinpgx
justification: Despite the name, the file encodes no CPIC table; it drives the ClinPGx REST API at api.clinpgx.org with 2 req/sec rate limiting, 24-hour local caching, and a fixed CSV output schema. The pharmcat binary signal comes from one attribution string at clinpgx.py:534, never a call.

name: cnv-acmg-classifier
justification: Reproduces the ClinGen/ACMG 2019 point framework (Riggs et al. 2020) section by section: 2A +1.00, 2F -1.00, 2C-1/2D-4 +0.90 from breakpoint geometry, Section 3 gene-count tiers, and the symmetric tier thresholds Pathogenic at or above +0.99 down to Benign at or below -0.99, all of which a capable agent could rebuild with the published standard open.

name: crispr-screen-triage
justification: The fixed rubric is the asset: score = 0.55*max(0,-median_log2FC) + 0.25*druggability + 0.20*essentiality, with high priority requiring score >= 1.35 and median log2FC <= -1.0. It explicitly fetches nothing from DepMap, Open Targets or ChEMBL; annotations must already be columns in the input table.

name: data-extractor
justification: Four-phase pipeline of panel detection, pre-analysis, OpenCV pixel-level marker and bar calibration, then heuristic validation of axis range, series count and error bar polarity, driving Claude Sonnet for detection and Opus for extraction behind ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

name: de-summary
justification: Spec-only with no script, but too detailed to call a stub: it is a refusal list for a task the model does natively (do not re-run the DE, do not run GO/KEGG enrichment, apply padj < 0.05 AND |log2FC| >= 1.0 strictly, sort padj ascending) plus two sanity gates, flagging GAPDH/ACTB/TUBB in the significant set as a normalisation fault and >30% significant as a batch effect.

name: deepspot-m
justification: Model call is three lines; the durable value is what it refuses and records: exact 224x224 rejection, --skip-background refusal, per_gene_uncertainty set to null 'because an absent key reads as high confidence', per-row provenance so a demo_fixture cannot read as a model run, and pinned revision 86113ee4.

name: diff-visualizer
justification: The work is driving matplotlib/anndata/scanpy over upstream output layouts it must recognise: tables/de_results.csv from rnaseq-de, tables/contrastive_markers_full.csv and within_cluster_contrastive_markers_full.csv from scrna-orchestrator, emitting volcano/MA/heatmap figures plus report.html, and degrading gracefully when anndata context is unavailable.

name: dnasp
justification: Reimplements DnaSP 6 with each formula traced to its source (Simonsen 1995 eq. A3/A5 variance coefficients, Nei-Gojobori 1986 Ka/Ks, Wright 1990 ENC, Hudson 1992 Fst) and pins a demo expected-value table (S=5, Hd=0.9556, Tajima's D=0.6789, ENC=23.00).

name: drug-photo
justification: The file's substance is the CPIC table of 51 drugs across 12 genes, including the CYP2C9+VKORC1 multi-gene warfarin row, plus the four classification labels STANDARD, CAUTION, AVOID and INSUFFICIENT DATA. It ships no code of its own and every CLI example invokes skills/pharmgx-reporter/pharmgx_reporter.py.

name: drug-repurposing-screen
justification: The statistics are published heuristics the file spells out for hand-execution (SSMD cutoff 1.5, viability < 0.5, robust z < -2.0, SAS bimodality bc >= 0.55), so what does not transfer is the refusals: Safety requires an explicit objective.yaml target and off-target sample_info_query with no implicit cancer default, Gotcha 3 keeps BH-FDR within each feature type, and those queries run through a restricted AST evaluator.

name: eqtl-catalogue-region-fetch
justification: Gotcha 1 is the whole asset: the v2 REST /datasets/{id}/associations endpoint silently truncates regional fetches and ignores pos_min/pos_max, so fetches must go through tabix on the FTP .all.tsv.gz. Also requires molecular_trait_id filtering for bundled ge files.

name: equity-scorer
justification: What is lost is a metric definition: the HEIM composite with fixed default weights w1=0.35, w2=0.25, w3=0.20, w4=0.20, its four named terms, the five-band 0-100 interpretation table, and the GLOBAL_PROPORTIONS 1000 Genomes superpopulation constants in equity_scorer.py; the underlying heterozygosity, Nei's GST and PCA steps are textbook.

name: fastreer
justification: Drives the fastreeR Java backend (VCF2TREE, VCF2DIST, DIST2TREE, FASTA2DIST); the encoded knowledge is operational, e.g. the JVM heap rule 4*n_samples^2*threads/1e6 MB, the Java 11+ precheck instead of a cryptic JVM crash, and that --window-bp output is multi-block and must not be parsed as a single matrix.

name: fine-mapping
justification: Implements published formulas with cited defaults: ABF prior W = 0.04 from Wakefield 2009, SuSiE IBSS from Wang et al. 2020, and the SuSiE-inf infinitesimal variance component from Cui et al. 2024, with 95 percent credible set coverage, max signals L = 10 and a 0.5 purity filter. Pure Python, no R and no external binary.

name: flow-bio
justification: A pure REST client for one SaaS tenant: POST /login for a JWT (5-minute access, 7-day refresh), offset pagination, 1 MB chunked upload, and polling GET /executions/<id> to a terminal state. Triage says mentions-external-binary for nextflow and nf-core, which appear only as a frontmatter tag, prose about Flow hosting Nextflow pipelines, and a citation link; requires.bins is python3 only.

name: galaxy-bridge
justification: Executes remotely through BioBlend against usegalaxy.org with a search, configure, upload, run, poll, retrieve sequence and fully qualified tool IDs such as toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/devteam/fastqc/fastqc/0.74+galaxy1, gated on GALAXY_API_KEY.

name: genome-compare
justification: The asset is deposited data plus textbook maths, not orchestration: the bundled CC0 George Church PGP-1 (hu43860C) 569,226-SNP 23andMe file in data/, scored by an IBS overlap and an EM admixture pass over ancestry-informative markers; genome_compare.py imports only numpy, matplotlib and clawbio.common parsers, with no PLINK or subprocess call anywhere.

name: genome-match
justification: Documents a fixed composite rubric (40% heterozygosity, 40% trait complementarity, 20% recessive disease-risk penalty) plus greedy non-overlapping pair selection. The file is a thin CLI shim that execs GENOMEBOOK/PYTHON/02-genomematch.py against a private GENOMEBOOK/DATA/GENOMES tree; the weights are invented rather than publicly authoritative, so D1 is assigned on the reconstructability test only.

name: gi-annotation
justification: Submits POST /v1/tasks/annotation/predict with Prefer: respond-async and polls GET /v1/tasks/jobs/{job_id}, and enforces the published 1,000 to 500,000 bp minLength/maxLength locally before spending a request, distinguishing a 422 validation_failed from the separate 16 MiB 413 raw-body cap.

name: gi-chromatin
justification: The whole file is the calling contract for one hosted endpoint: POST /v1/tasks/chromatin/predict, the 200 to 500,000 bp bounds rejected locally before spending a request, 422 validation_failed for out-of-bounds against the separate 413 16 MiB body cap, RateLimit-Remaining surfaced into result.json, and read track names from data.tracks rather than hardcoding indices.

name: gi-enhancer
justification: Thin wrapper whose knowledge is the hosted API contract: POST /v1/tasks/enhancer/predict, 50 to 500,000 bp bounds rejected locally before spending a request, 422 validation_failed distinguished from the separate 413 16 MiB body cap, and a 249 bp context_window_bp caveat.

name: gi-expression
justification: Nearly all the content is the contract for one remote endpoint, POST /v1/tasks/expression/predict: the 9,198 bp scored window cut server-side, the 9,198-500,000 bp bounds with --tss-index, 422 validation_failed versus the separate 413 16 MiB body cap, tss_index errors reporting at loc ["body"] and never body.tss_index, and the warning that a wrong --tss-index returns a confident number for the wrong window rather than an error.

name: gi-promoter
justification: Entirely a client for POST /v1/tasks/promoter/predict; encodes the 300-500,000 bp bounds checked locally before spending a request, the 422-vs-413 distinction, RateLimit-Limit and Retry-After handling on 429, and the strand gotcha where the bundled TP53 fixture calls promoter windows gene-sense and none on the genomic strand.

name: gi-splice
justification: Drives POST /v1/tasks/splice/predict and carries the output-format quirks: a called site's start/end bounds a variable-width tokenizer token rather than a junction base, and a wrong-strand submission returns comparably confident sites with nothing in the counts or scores to reveal it.

name: gwas-catalog-region-fetch
justification: Value is driving one source correctly: a tabix byte-range fetch on <GCST>/harmonised/<GCST>.h.tsv.gz and never the raw upload one directory up (which can be GRCh37 with study-specific allele conventions), the hm_* to canonical column mapping with alt as the effect allele, the hasSummaryStats precheck, and the harmoniser dropping palindromic SNPs at MAF near 0.5.

name: gwas-lookup
justification: Fans one rsID across 9 heterogeneous endpoints in parallel via ThreadPoolExecutor, and the Databases Queried table carries the real trap: Biobank Japan PheWeb returns GRCh37 while the other eight are GRCh38. The vep signal is the Ensembl REST /vep path, not a local binary.

name: gwas-pipeline
justification: Requires plink2 and regenie on PATH and sequences them: PLINK2 missingness/MAF/HWE QC with LD pruning, REGENIE Step 1 whole-genome ridge regression with LOCO, Step 2 single-variant association with Firth correction for binary traits, then lambda GC and lead-variant extraction at P < 5e-8, with every command logged to reproducibility/commands.sh.

name: gwas-prs
justification: Value is provenance and refusal, not the additive dosage sum: the bundled CLAWBIO-* panels are documented as NOT PGS Catalog scores (PGS000001 shares 60 of 77 rsIDs with 31 weights differing by more than 0.02), must never be cited as a published PRS result, and provenance.json hashes every scoring file while stating the trait fingerprint does not anonymise the query.

name: hla-typing
justification: hla_typing.py run_analysis contains the comment TODO: implement core hla-typing logic and returns findings: [] with status: skeleton. SKILL.md matches: Key thresholds reads TODO: define thresholds with citations, Citations reads TODO, and the example output rows read Example finding 1. No HLA nomenclature, reference database or caller is named anywhere.

name: illumina-bridge
justification: Despite the name it is not a cloud orchestrator: it scans a local DRAGEN export, merges sample rows across the [Data], [BCLConvert_Data] and [Cloud_TSO500S_Data] SampleSheet sections, prefers Results/*hard-filtered.vcf, and maps DRAGEN MetricsOutput.tsv aliases into stable keys such as yield_gb and percent_q30. The vendor format handling is the work; ICA is opt-in metadata-only enrichment behind ILLUMINA_ICA_API_KEY.

name: just-prs-mcp
justification: Scoring is delegated upstream; what is lost is abstention and disclosure: absolute risk withheld on build_mismatch ('enforced, not merely advised'), a visible warning when the EUR default is applied, C_wt retained over match rate, and n_filtered/filter_summary so an empty curated list is not read as failure.

name: labstep
justification: The body of the file is the labstepPy call surface (user.getExperiment/getProtocol/getResourceItem, protocol.getSteps/getInventoryFields, item.getLineageParents) plus the LABSTEP_API_KEY resolution with .claude/settings.json fallback and the ProseMirror gotcha that protocol body text lives on protocol-collection.last_version.state; labstep.py calls labstep.authenticate and user.getExperiments/getProtocols/getResources live, with the demo JSONs only as an offline fallback.

name: ld-1000g-region-compute
justification: Encodes external-binary quirks: plink 1.9 with --vcf assigns FID=IID so the --keep file must repeat the sample id per row, where a plink2-era FID=0 file fails with 'No people remaining after --keep'; and --set-missing-var-ids '@:#:$1:$2' rewrites the '.' ID column of 1000G GRCh38 VCFs before --r2.

name: lit-synthesizer
justification: Drives NCBI E-utilities esearch and efetch plus the bioRxiv details endpoint, enforcing a 0.34 s sleep for the unauthenticated 3 requests/second limit and parsing efetch XML. The bioRxiv quirk that results are date-ordered rather than keyword-ranked forces local filtering after fetch.

name: locuscompare-region-render
justification: Sequences four external sources for one figure: tabix on eQTL Catalogue and GWAS Catalog FTP, plink 1.9 --r2 against 1000G Phase 3 GRCh38, and Ensembl REST for the GENCODE track, recording plink_version and n_palindromic_excluded in manifest.yaml. It also refuses to render on mismatched window coverage and substitutes an r2 > 0.8 proxy when the lead is missing from one side.

name: marker-dominance-mapper
justification: Centre of gravity is a four-row lineage-marker mapping any capable agent could restate: EPCAM to tumor_core, PTPRC to immune_edge, COL1A1 to stromal_zone, MKI67 to proliferative_core, with x and y used only to draw the SVG. Its only data file is a 219-byte six-spot demo CSV.

name: mendelian-randomisation
justification: Every estimator and cut-off is published and reconstructible: IVW with multiplicative random effects (Burgess 2013), MR-Egger slope and intercept (Bowden 2015), weighted median (Bowden 2016), weighted mode (Hartwig 2017), F > 10 from Staiger and Stock 1997, I2_GX > 0.9 for Egger validity, and the STROBE-MR reporting frame.

name: methylation-clock
justification: Drives PyAging clocks (Horvath2013, AltumAge, PCGrimAge, GrimAge2, DunedinPACE) from a GEO accession or local array, converting tabular input to AnnData and emitting a missing_features.csv diagnostic for CpGs a clock needs. It ships data/GSE139307_small.csv.gz with a PROVENANCE.md, which the inventory records as zero data files.

name: multiqc-reporter
justification: Shells out to multiqc with --outdir and flattens report_general_stats_data from multiqc_data/multiqc_data.json. The load-bearing quirk is that MultiQC exits 0 even when it recognised no files, so an empty report is explicitly not treated as an error.

name: ncbi-datasets
justification: Entirely subcommand and flag selection for two external CLIs that the frontmatter declares as required bins (datasets, dataformat): --dehydrated then unzip then 'datasets rehydrate --max-workers 20', --preview before multi-GB transfers, and piping --as-json-lines into 'dataformat tsv genome --fields'. Triage called it no-signal because neither binary is in the scanner's tool vocabulary.

name: nfcore-rnaseq-wrapper
justification: Deepest orchestration in the batch: pins nf-core/rnaseq 3.26.0, writes params.input to satisfy the upstream ^\S+\.csv$ schema, enforces odd 1..31 pseudo-aligner k-mer size, scans only the first 10 GTF feature records for GENCODE, and rejects --resume on profile, aligner or checksum drift.

name: nfcore-sarek-wrapper
justification: Pure invocation knowledge for nf-core/sarek 3.8.1: the 25-profile composition space, the per-patient tool-by-mode matrix (ascat/msisensorpro/muse paired-only, lofreq/msisensor2 tumor-only), the MISSING_REFERENCE preflight for BQSR known sites, the MarkDuplicatesSpark versus UMI incompatibility, and the split_fastq 50M default that makes a normal run legitimately differ from -profile test on tiny inputs.

name: nfcore-scrnaseq-wrapper
justification: Pins nf-core/scrnaseq 4.1.0 and encodes its operational edges: Java >= 17 and Nextflow >= 25.04.0 compared as zero-padded version tuples to avoid (24,4) < (24,4,0) false negatives, skip_emptydrops translated to skip_cellbender, and an outputs parser that ranks .h5ad at both mtx_conversions depths per conf/modules.config rather than hard-coding filenames.

name: nutrigx
justification: data/snp_panel.json plus the SKILL.md tables encode roughly 35 curated SNPs with effect directions such as MTHFR rs1801133 reducing 5-MTHF conversion by about 70 percent, a 0/0.5/1.0 scoring scheme, 0-3/3-6/6-10 risk bands, and the rs4988235 dominant_protective rule where only GG scores as lactase non-persistence.

name: omics-target-evidence-mapper
justification: A thin SKILL.md (74 lines, no Trigger, Gotchas or Agent Boundary section) but judgeable: capabilities 2 to 5 are retrievals, and the script fans out to UniProt, Open Targets, PubMed and trials through one safe_request_json that warns and returns None on failure, then writes checksums.sha256, environment.yml and an RO-Crate 1.1 provenance record.

name: organ-aging-studio
justification: Encodes a published clock: predicted_age = intercept + sum(protein_NPX x coefficient) over pinned Goeminne organAging coefficients (Cell Metabolism 2025, DOI 10.1016/j.cmet.2024.10.005), with Gompertz gen2 conversion and Table S3 standard deviations required to rescale non-Olink input.

name: pathway-enricher
justification: It is an Enrichr REST client: POST the gene list to https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/addList, then GET six pinned libraries (KEGG_2021_Human, GO_Biological_Process_2023, GO_Molecular_Function_2023, GO_Cellular_Component_2023, Reactome_2022, WikiPathways_2023_Human) with a 0.5 s inter-query delay, ranking on Enrichr's combined score and filtering at adjusted p < 0.05.

name: pharmgx-reporter
justification: PGX_SNPS maps rsIDs to CPIC star alleles inline (rs4244285 to CYP2C19*2 no_function, rs12248560 to *17 increased_function) and phenotypes to AVOID/CAUTION/STANDARD drug buckets, citing CPIC and the FDA PGx biomarker table. Verified it makes no network calls: the only Ensembl references are two comment lines at pharmgx_reporter.py:965-966 and a test comment, never a request.

name: phylogenetics-builder
justification: Chains mafft, trimal -automated1, iqtree2 -m MFP and raxml-ng, and carries their version quirks: adapt_model_for_engine strips +F from ModelFinder's TIM3+F+G4 because RAxML-NG rejects it, prank writes {prefix}.best.fas, and the UFBoot cutoff is 95 rather than the standard bootstrap 70.

name: polars-bio
justification: A wrapper over one library's API surface whose durable content is that library's failure modes: the BED reader silently returns 0 rows below 4 columns, complement without --genome runs trailing gaps to i64::MAX, operations return LazyFrames, nested GFF/VCF columns fall back to result.ndjson. Triage says mentions-external-binary for bedtools, samtools and multiqc, which occur only as a comparison ('a bioframe/bedtools alternative'), an error-hint string ('samtools index aln.bam') and a chaining partner.

name: profile-report
justification: No computation of its own; the guarantee is the deliverable: 'Reads validated skill outputs only, never re-computes or hallucinates results', and missing skills render informative placeholders rather than errors. Its 45 KB data file is demo_full_profile.json, a fixture.

name: proteomics-clock
justification: The skill is a carrier for published parameters: Goeminne et al. 2025 elastic net coefficients pulled from the organAging repo pinned at commit 5147b03 with SHA-256 sidecar verification, 23 organ clocks across gen1 and gen2, and the Gompertz constants intercept -9.946, slope 0.0898, average relative log-hazard -4.802.

name: proteomics-de
justification: Encodes a Perseus-style parameter set: the MaxQuant Reverse / Potential contaminant / Only identified by site filters, down-shifted Gaussian imputation at shift=1.8 and scale=0.3, and s0=0.1 with FDR=0.05 per Giai Gianetto 2016. It reads MaxQuant and DIA-NN output files rather than driving either tool, so the loss is the parameter set, not invocation.

name: protocols-io
justification: Client for GET /api/v3/protocols and /api/v4/protocols/<id>?content_format=markdown with a client-side sliding-window 100 requests/minute throttle, Retry-After back-off capped at 3 retries on HTTP 429, the stricter 5/minute PDF endpoint, and token expiry signalled by status 1219.

name: pubmed-summariser
justification: Two E-utilities calls (esearch then efetch) with the '<term> AND english[la]' query sorted by date, the tool=clawbio&email= attribution required by NCBI policy, a 10-second timeout and an ElementTree parse. The briefing itself is native model work, and at 104 lines the file has no Gotchas or Agent Boundary section to add a contract.

name: rare-disease-rnaseq
justification: Method is a published robust statistic plus a gene list: modified z = 0.6745 (x - median) / MAD on log2(CPM+1), flagged at |z| >= 3 and filtered by the bundled 50-gene data/disease_panel.csv. STAR and Salmon appear only in the Production Path comparison table; the script invokes neither.

name: rare-high-impact-variants
justification: The LoF term set and --max-af 0.01 are thin; the real content is the refusal in Gotcha 1, that absence of a population frequency is never counted as rare (the CASP12 nonsense case), so frequency-unknown gets its own bucket and the headline count is documented-rare only, with the stated consequence that counting absent AF as rare inflates the headline by an order of magnitude.

name: recombinator
justification: Fixes simulation parameters: a 0.1% per-locus de novo mutation rate with cognitive, immune and metabolic hotspot multipliers, 50/50 sex determination, and a health score from disease-registry fitness costs. The file execs GENOMEBOOK/PYTHON/04-recombinator.py over a private GENOMEBOOK trait and disease registry; parameters are invented rather than published, so D1 rests on the reconstructability test.

name: repro-enforcer
justification: The directory contains SKILL.md and nothing else: no script, no tests. The file is 51 lines listing seven capabilities and ends with Status: Planned, implementation targeting Week 6 (Apr 3-9). There is no implementation to judge.

name: rnaseq-de
justification: The thinnest real skill here: 102 lines with no Trigger, Gotchas or Agent Boundary, just an input contract (counts matrix, metadata carrying sample_id, formula '~ batch + condition', contrast 'condition,treated,control') wrapped round a PyDESeq2 run with QC and PCA, which is why confidence is low. Triage says mentions-external-binary for nf-core and salmon, which occur only inside tests/test_rnaseq_de.py.

name: sample-qc-triage
justification: Algorithm is five documented cut-offs: fingerprint_match_pct < 95, complexity_score < 0.60 or duplicate_pct > 35, contamination_pct > 5, mapped_pct < 80, mitochondrial_pct > 15. PLINK and MultiQC appear only in the scope line disclaiming VerifyBamID, Conpair, Somalier and PLINK IBD, and as a chaining partner.

name: scrna-embedding
justification: Drives scvi-tools correctly end to end: trains scvi.model.SCVI on HVG raw counts with an optional batch covariate, refines with scvi.model.SCANVI given --labels-key and --unlabeled-category, writes obsm["X_scvi"] then runs neighbors with use_rep="X_scvi" and UMAP, and exports integrated.h5ad carrying log-normalized X plus layers["counts"]; it also rejects processed-like matrices at input.

name: scrna-orchestrator
justification: Fixes a Scanpy call sequence (normalize_total to 1e4, log1p, HVG flavor 'seurat', scale max_value=10, rank_genes_groups with method 'wilcoxon' and pts=True) and handles h5ad and 10x Matrix Market input, rejecting processed matrices unless raw counts survive in layers['counts']; CellTypist runtime model downloads are deliberately disabled.

name: seq-wrangler
justification: Fixes the samtools ordering MAPQ filter, sort -n, fixmate, coordinate sort, markdup, index with a default --mapq 20, and documents the 2G-RAM-per-thread sort OOM and that --index takes an aligner index prefix such as hg38_chr22 rather than a .fa or .bt2 path.

name: skill-builder
justification: A repo-governance tool, not a science tool: it renders the 13 required SKILL.md sections, runs the CONTRIBUTING conformance checklist against the generated file before writing it, normalises names to lowercase-hyphen, and registers the result in catalog.json plus the SKILLS dict in clawbio.py. Triage says mentions-external-binary for plink, fastqc and multiqc; plink sits in an Example Query line and the other two are placeholder text in an interactive prompt, while Dependencies states stdlib only, zero install.

name: soul2dna
justification: Only asset present is the documented trait-score to genotype cut-off table (additive <0.33 / 0.33-0.66 / >0.66, dominant <0.40 / 0.40-0.75, recessive <0.50 / 0.50-0.80). soul2dna.py is a 112-line shim that exec_modules GENOMEBOOK/PYTHON/01-soul2dna.py, outside the skills tree, and the mapping is an invented convention with no external authority.

name: struct-predictor
justification: struct_predictor.py imports run_boltz from struct_predictor_core.predict and shells Boltz-2 out, then parses its native artefacts: per-residue pLDDT from the CIF B-factors and the PAE matrix from confidence_[name]_model_0.json, with the msa: empty versus .a3m versus --use_msa_server option table being the invocation knowledge that matters.

name: target-validation-scorer
justification: Despite naming five databases it queries none of them: 'Gather evidence' is explicitly the agent's responsibility and the skill scores a supplied JSON, so it is not orchestration. What would be lost is the contract, above all 'Missing data is not zero evidence' (a failed query yields a null sub-score at confidence low, never 0), plus conflicts surfaced rather than averaged and every evidence object citing a database and retrieval date.

name: turingdb-graph
justification: Works around named TuringDB defects: LOAD GML stores properties as displayName (String) requiring backtick-escaped access, GROUP BY returns incorrect aggregations so all counting moves to pandas groupby().nunique(), there is no MERGE so LOAD CSV + CREATE never dedupes, and writes outside new_change() and CHANGE SUBMIT do not persist.

name: ukb-navigator
justification: What deletion loses is convenient access to a public mapping: the Data Sources table names ukb_schema.csv and schema_27.txt and the worked lookup is field 21001 = BMI, all of it republished in the UK Biobank Data Showcase. The ChromaDB plus optional Voyage voyage-3 layer around it is generic retrieval plumbing, which is why I am not confident between D1 and D2 here.

name: ukb-ppp-region-fetch
justification: Encodes Synapse and REGENIE handling: resolves <HGNC>_<UniProt>_<OlinkID>_v1_<Panel>.tar under syn51364943, matches chr<N> on a strict word boundary so chr1 cannot pull chr10, converts LOG10P to linear p with underflow clamped to 0.0, and folds A1FREQ above 0.5 to MAF.

name: variant-annotation
justification: The hard part is driving Ensembl VEP REST and normalising what it returns: pysam.VariantFile parsing to one record per ALT, POST batches of 200 to rest.ensembl.org/vep/homo_sapiens/region under the 15 requests per second fair-use limit with local caching, most-severe-consequence collapsing across transcript/regulatory/motif blocks, then ClinVar bucketing and a gnomAD AF < 0.001 rule feeding Tier 1 to Tier 4.

name: vcf-annotator
justification: Drives three REST services with distinct ID conventions: Ensembl VEP /vep/human/hgvs/, NCBI E-utilities esearch on clinvar, and gnomAD GraphQL keyed {chrom}-{pos}-{ref}-{alt} with the chr prefix stripped, plus a 0.1s sleep for the ~15 req/s VEP limit. Its own gotcha concedes live ClinVar returns presence only, with classifications supplied from demo data.

name: wes-clinical-report-en
justification: Fixes a nine-section clinical report contract, parsing sections 1-7 then adding ancestry as 8 and limitations as 9 with a mandatory disclaimer, and requires the caveats that PGx star alleles are SNV-only with no CYP2D6 CNV so complete metaboliser phenotyping must not be claimed, and that tables over 20 rows are silently truncated in the PDF.

name: wgs-prs
justification: Sequences three external systems end to end: nf-core/sarek under nextflow with GATK HaplotypeCaller, then bcftools normalisation and hard filters, then the gwas-prs skill against the PGS Catalog, gated on fixed thresholds (Ti/Tv 1.8 to 2.5, Het/Hom 1.0 to 3.0, QUAL >= 30, DP >= 10) that fail fast unless --no-fail-fast, with the GRCh37-produces-silently-wrong-PRS warning as the sharpest gotcha.

name: xena-tcga-gene-query
justification: API call is a plain GET; the durable content is the anti-hallucination and statistics contract: answer 'never from general knowledge or training data', report sample sizes before effect sizes, and frame minimum-p optimal cutoffs as exploratory because they are not corrected for multiple cutoff testing.
